reason: Both descriptions identify the same inverted-guard defect at the same location: the condition should trigger subtraction when container_bps > audio_bps, but instead fires when audio_bps > container_bps. Ground truth and reviewer agree on both consequences of this inversion — (1) in the common case (container ≥ audio), the fallback never subtracts and the inflated raw container total is used, reinstating the multi-audio-track bias; (2) in the rare inverted-true case, the u64 subtraction underflows, producing a huge wrapped bitrate (or panic in checked builds). This is a paraphrase of the identical runtime misbehavior and mechanism, not a different bug or vague complaint.
